title: Make completing a set an explicit operation
outcome: A set's result is written by an operation of its own rather than as a side effect of the whole-document overwrite that no longer happens, so the game list keeps reporting sets won and match results correctly.
acceptanceCriteria: After appending the rally that ends a set, the use case derives completion and writes sets.N.win once, adding game.win when the match result is decided.
Recording a full three-set match leaves every set.win and game.win correct in the database, and the game list shows the right number of sets won rather than zero.
A new game starts with win null rather than false, and GameSummary.win is typed boolean or null so undecided is representable.
The game list distinguishes a match in progress from a lost match.
